smoke.note: The two flights used different hardware and diagnostics and their values differ by about a factor of two. They are kept as two tables and never averaged.

blue_flame_quote.quote: the flame shrinks to a hemispherical blue flame and oscillates with increasing amplitude just before going out

partial_gravity_wording: Spread rate vs gravity is non-monotonic in the models and in low-conductivity-core wire tests, with a maximum and a minimum flammability O2 near lunar gravity; thin-cellulose KC-135 data at 0.2–0.4 atm are monotonic in g over 0.1–1 g. The peak location is material-, geometry- and pressure-dependent and is not yet fixed by a lunar-surface measurement — that is what FM2 is for.
